title: Live board
description: A settled box-office board for one night at Knockdown Center. The four metrics no longer share a chart: tickets sold is a column of 15-minute buckets that peaks at doors, gross volume is a drawn cumulative curve, sell-through is a capacity bar segmented by ticket tier against the 2,050 seat rule, and refunds is a sparse stem plot that sits empty until the first one lands. Nothing ticks — the ledger of 1,043 orders is finished and steady, so every value on screen is settled and the motion belongs to you. The order tape below carries the whole night; hover, arrow or pin a row and the board rewinds to that order at once — digits roll back, the curve clips to that minute, the columns behind the cursor step down, the capacity segments shrink to the seats sold by then with a marker left at the final level, and each card shows what that single order contributed. Escape or the reading pill in the header returns to final.
intent: A real product surface with realistic content and every state built out, serving Herb's preference for dense typographic data UI on a light Swiss ground over abstract visual demos.
